_comment: zw-brain design-contract stats only. sync-stats lives in scripts/ for CI without an external dev-rules checkout. Numbers wrapped here must earn their keep — each entry is a real contract whose drift implies a real product-boundary change. Decorative counts (snapshot totals, fake per-journey GATE budgets) were intentionally removed; their absence is a feature, not an oversight.

legacy.import.schemas.description: Number of mysqldump schemas under old/10示例数据/ (each *.sql = one schema dump). Dumps are .gitignored — when absent (e.g. CI runner), compute outputs empty and sync-stats skips this key with a WARN, preserving local drift-detection without false-positive in CI.
legacy.import.schemas.compute: if ls 'old/10示例数据/'*.sql >/dev/null 2>&1; then ls 'old/10示例数据/'*.sql | wc -l | tr -d ' '; fi

legacy.import.tables-total.description: Total CREATE TABLE count across all dump files (raw — includes shadow/copy tables; the importer filters at mapper level). grep -a forces text mode because some dumps contain stray bytes that trip grep's binary heuristic. Empty when dumps absent (see schemas).
legacy.import.tables-total.compute: if ls 'old/10示例数据/'*.sql >/dev/null 2>&1; then for f in 'old/10示例数据/'*.sql; do grep -ac '^CREATE TABLE' "$f"; done | awk '{s+=$1} END {print s+0}'; fi

legacy.import.record-classes.description: Count of SQLAlchemy Record classes in zw_brain/domain/models.py (the canonical model surface).

legacy.import.missing-records.description: Count of M-numbered rows in legacy-import-mapping §二 missing-record table (M1, M2, ... — items the mapping doc flags as not yet covered by a Record class).

legacy.import.missing-resolved.description: Count of M1–M6 records (the §二 'P2 blocking' subset) actually present in domain/models.py — once this hits 6, the mapping doc's blocking note is fully discharged.

zwbrain.manifest-total.description: zw-brain: capability_registry on-disk manifest 总数 (live + deferred + external)。仅供 preflight-debt 等 transient context 引用——不是契约。若某条 prose 必须写一个 manifest 数字，wrap 这个 stat；多数情况下应反问数字该不该出现。
zwbrain.manifest-total.compute: if [ -d zw_brain/capability_registry/registered ]; then ls zw_brain/capability_registry/registered/*.json 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '; else echo 0; fi
